uncertain: 野性化: Jigoku shipped 'Aggressive Beast' (16, over the 13 cap; Jigoku expanded it at draw time). Shortened to 'Aggr. Beast'.
震動剣: Akurasu (Z3.R) calls it 'Shocking Sword' (14, too long); used 'Vibro Sword' from the meaning (vibration sword). Owner not verified.

遠距離操作 'Remote Op.', 物質転送 'Mat. Transfer', 反骨心 'Rebel Heart', 戦術待機 'Tac. Standby' are compact forms of Akurasu's Long Distance Operation / Material Transfer / Rebellious Heart / Tactical Standby. The individual-command names in the skill descriptions (「テレパシー」「遠距離操作」「物質転送」) stay Japanese here; if the command menu is translated elsewhere it should match.
report.notes: Names follow Akurasu's Z3.R (Tengoku) Pilot Abilities page where they fit 13 chars: Battle Mode, Telepathy, Topless (glossary), Psychokinesis, Wild Heart, Pressure (official SRW), Survivability, Positioning, Single Attack, Terrain Use. 決戦モード Akurasu 'Decisive Battle Mode' -> 'Decisive Mode'. 野性の勘 'Wild Heart' kept distinct from 野性化.
